notes: Legal description transcribed verbatim from Book 7103 Page 249 (PDF page 3); the previous text abbreviated the courses as "thence (1) through (11)". All eleven courses match the deed as printed, so the 0.089 ft misclosure is the deed's own. This deed transfers the consolidated Lots 11, 11.01, and 12.01 from MSSK LLC to Select Real Estate LLC as part of the Willits Court subdivision. It was subsequently subdivided into individual townhouse lots (12.02 through 12.13). The parcel shape is irregular because it wraps around the corner from Kings Highway West to Washington Avenue.
